parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body&&typeof $json.body==='object'&&!Array.isArray($json.body)?$json.body:$json;const clean=v=>typeof v==='string'?v.trim():'';const details=input.details&&typeof input.details==='object'&&!Array.isArray(input.details)?input.details:{};const errors=[];if(clean(input.eventType).length<3)errors.push('eventType is required');if(clean(input.actor).length<2)errors.push('actor is required');if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(details,'contactEmail')||Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(details,'contactName'))errors.push('audit details must not include contact data');const dbId=clean(input.requestDbId);if(dbId&&!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(dbId))errors.push('requestDbId must be a UUID when provided');if(errors.length)return[{json:{valid:false,status:'rejected',errors}}];return[{json:{valid:true,status:'accepted',requestDbId:dbId||null,eventType:clean(input.eventType),actor:clean(input.actor),details:{stage:clean(details.stage)||'unknown',status:clean(details.status)||'unknown',promptVersion:clean(details.promptVersion)||'local-deterministic-v1',durationMs:Number(details.durationMs)||0,inputTokens:Number(details.inputTokens)||0,outputTokens:Number(details.outputTokens)||0,estimatedCostUsd:Number(details.estimatedCostUsd)||0,approvalStatus:clean(details.approvalStatus)||null,errorCount:Number(details.errorCount)||0}}}];
